how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_011.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire.descri: A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_lord.d: A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_overco: Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.wicked_oni.des: A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight.descript: A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight_king.des: A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.abnormal_cond: Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.
Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absolute_seve: Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absorb_and_di: Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_rain.des: Summon an acidic cloud which will corrode any afflicted entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_shell.de: Shoots a ball of corrosive acid toward targets.
Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.agility.descr: Greatly enhance the caster's movement speed.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.air_flight.de: Use your aura to propel you forward, and hover in air.
Drain out all the air surrounding the targets and suffocate them.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.all_seeing_ey: Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analyst.descr: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analytical_ap: Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_magic_ar: Creates a zone around the user that limits all Aspectual and Summoning Magics.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_shock_ar: Creates a zone around the user that limits all physical damage taken.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_skill.de: Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.antidote.desc: Recover a living being from nausea, poison and weakness.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_shield.d: Create a shield of condensed aura to block attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_slash.de: Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_sword.de: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.barrier.descr: Coat the caster with a Physical Barrier with the strength based on Health.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.battlewill.de: Channel your will, converting magicules into aura.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.beast_transfo: Transform into a beast to restore your vitality and boost your physical body. The transformation will grant great physical prowess but leave a toll on your body.
